classes.MATCH: The headline reports an event of the routed template family at the resolved issuer, and at least one attached filing reports that event.
classes.NO_EVENT: The headline reports no issuer event of the template family (market report, commentary, list, quote page, solicitation).
classes.OTHER_EVENT: The headline event is real and the resolved issuer is its subject, but no attached filing reports it.
classes.WRONG_ISSUER: The resolved issuer is not the subject of the headline.

verdicts.note: Dividend-safety question piece; the attached filing is a results release and the headline reports no capital-return event.
Dividend-declaration headline; the only attached filing reports a director appointment.
Dividend-declaration headline; the graded filing and its exhibit report the declaration.
Commentary on a cut to the current-year revenue outlook; the attached investor update carries the current-year revenue guidance.
Guidance-raise headline about another company; the resolved issuer appears only as a merger counterparty.
Backlog preview piece ahead of results; the headline reports no demand or guidance event.
Roundup list; the headline reports no issuer event.
Offering headline; the graded filing reports only preliminary revenue, and the offering appears only in a filing the wider band added.
Market research report headline; the headline reports no issuer event.
Offering-pricing headline; the attached filing reports the underwriting agreement for the offering.
Forecast given at the results event; the graded results filing reports the same results event.
Commentary on a multi-year capital spending plan; the attached results release reports only current-year capital expectations and growth targets, not the plan.
Preferred-offering pricing headline; the graded filings report the offering.
Commentary on a raised full-year outlook; the graded results release carries the raised outlook.
Collaboration-amendment headline; the attached filing reports the amendment as a material agreement.
Full-year outlook and cost-program headline; the attached filing reaffirms guidance and announces the program.
Explainer on a long dividend record; the headline reports no capital-return event.
Market reaction to results and outlook; the attached results release reports them.
Secondary-offering headline; the attached filing reports the underwriting agreement.
Outlook headline; the attached results release gives updated full-year expectations.
Conversion-rate announcement headline; the attached filing is a results release that does not report it.
Market reaction to results and raised guidance; the graded results release reports both.
Notes-offering headline; the attached filing reports the closed offering.
Offering-pricing headline; the attached filing reports the underwriting agreement.
Analysis piece on previously reported backlog ahead of results; the headline reports no new demand or guidance event.
Registered direct offering headline; the graded filing reports the purchase agreement and the offering.
Commentary on a past quarter's buybacks; the headline reports no new capital-return event and the attached filing is an investor-day presentation.
Exchange-offer extension headline; the attached filing reports regulatory clearances and only anticipates a later extension, not the one in the headline.
Dividend-streak extension headline; the attached results release reports the year's dividend increase that extends the streak.
Market reaction to forecasts given at the results event; the graded results release reports them.
